title: Staff onboarding portal
client: confidential
client_industry: healthcare staffing
start: 2021-05
end: 2021-09
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React

- TypeORM
- Auth0
implied_skills:

  with permissions per region.
metrics:
- 2,400 staff using it
- onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day

The review is from: a client in healthcare staffing (name withheld)
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

text: Tobias did solid work on our staff onboarding portal. He built a system where nurses could upload credentials and managers could approve them, with permissions set by region, and it handled 2,400 staff in use. The portal also cut onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day. Easy to work with and delivered what we needed.
